extraction_notes: The exact BZT52B12 row gives VZ minimum 11.76 V, nominal 12 V, and maximum 12.24 V at IZT = 5 mA; the nominal value and paired IZT are used for the zener breakdown fields.

The exact BZT52B12 row gives ZZT = 25 ohm at IZT = 5 mA, ZZK = 150 ohm at IZK = 1 mA, IR = 0.1 microA at VR = 8 V, and admissible IZM = 5 mA. Zener impedance and admissible-current fields are not represented by the strict schema.
The forward-voltage maximum is 0.9 V at IF = 10 mA from the maximum-ratings table. No reverse-recovery or tabulated capacitance value is published for this part.

The p. 3 Fig. 1 curve points are sparse approximate manual digitizations of the visibly labelled nominal 12 V trace; no points were interpolated between plotted observations. The other p. 3 plots are grouped series-level characteristics and were not attributed to the exact part.
